privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what information the school event calendar stores, why, who receives it and what your rights are.

sections.title: Who is responsible
sections.body: The system is operated by {company}. Each school's data (events, staff and settings) belongs to the school, and we process it on the school's behalf and under its instructions.

sections.title: Viewing without an account
sections.body: Parents, students and guests view the calendar through the school's link without signing up. We don't ask them for personal details. The hosting servers keep standard technical data, such as IP address and browser type, for security and operations.

sections.title: Staff information
sections.body: For staff who sign up we store name, email, role, school, permissions, sign-in attempts and an activity log (for example, who published or edited an event). Passwords are stored hashed by the identity provider and we never see them.

sections.title: Event content
sections.body: Event details a school publishes are visible to anyone who has the school's link. Do not put sensitive personal information about students in events.

sections.title: How we use information
sections.body: Only to run the system: show the calendar, manage permissions, secure accounts, handle support requests and improve the service. We send no marketing email and never sell the information.

sections.title: Who receives it
sections.body: Providers that run the system for us: Supabase (database and sign-in), Vercel (hosting and cookie-free aggregate performance metrics), Google (only if you choose Google sign-in), Groq (only when staff use the AI tools, to process the text entered) and GitHub (to track bug reports sent by staff). We also disclose information when the law requires it.

sections.title: Transfers outside Israel
sections.body: Some providers operate outside Israel, so information may be stored or transferred outside Israel, including the United States and Europe.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.body: The system only uses the cookies needed for staff sign-in. There are no advertising or tracking cookies.

sections.title: Retention
sections.body: Information is kept while the school uses the system and is then deleted as agreed with the school. Deactivated staff remain in the activity log to keep the record complete.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You can ask to see, correct or delete your information. Contact your school's management or us and we will handle the request. You can also contact the Privacy Protection Authority.

accessibility.title: Accessibility statement
accessibility.intro: We want the school event calendar to be accessible to everyone, including people with disabilities: parents, students and staff.
accessibility.levelBody: The system was adapted under the Equal Rights for Persons with Disabilities regulations and {standard}.
adjustments: Full keyboard navigation, including a skip-to-content link.
Headings, labels and semantic markup that work with screen readers.
Event types are marked by both color and symbol, so they can be told apart without seeing color.
Text zoom up to 200% and a phone-friendly layout.
Print layout that stays legible in black and white.
Automated accessibility checks on every code change.
accessibility.limitsBody: Despite our efforts, some parts of the system, such as the wide Gantt view, may not yet be fully accessible. The agenda view shows the same information as a simple list. If you run into a problem, tell us and we will help you get the information another way.
accessibility.contactBody: Found an accessibility problem? We will handle it promptly and within 60 days. Contact:
